author: slava77
body:
following on suggestion from https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/51245#issuecomment-5119259284 by @mmusich 

Overall, about a factor of 10 speedup from technical changes in `ExtendT5FromDupT5` kernel for the high-pt jets (2 TeV events) and some minor speedup in ttbar (this kernel itself was taking about 1/4 of the total LST processing time on CPU).
See details in the parent PR #51571

The 20_0_X backport is intended to:  "allow faster HLT execution over samples produced in the Phase 2 MC production using the native release (in master, CMSSW_20_1_X this is already merged, but I think there might be people still using the native release)."
title: LST: speedup ExtendT5FromDupT5 kernel [200X bport of #51571]
